statement: Build a single-page, phone-friendly website for Thread & Loom, a handloom clothing boutique at 18 FC Road, Shivajinagar, Pune, where visitors can browse and filter products, check sizes and new arrivals, see styled outfits, find the shop and its policies, and place orders on WhatsApp.
audience: Shoppers in Pune, mostly on phones, looking for handloom kurtas, sarees, cotton shirts and dupattas.
standards: Earthy and elegant look: natural, muted colours and a refined type style
Designed for phones first, and also works on desktop
No horizontal scrolling at 360px or 1280px width
No JavaScript errors; all in-page links go to a real section
Plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript in one file, no build step
rules: Use only the products, prices, sizes, policies, contact details and reviews the Requester supplied; never invent any
Photos are not available yet, so every product shows an empty photo spot
Orders go through WhatsApp only, to +91 00000 11111
done_when: The products section lists all 10 products with the exact names and prices supplied, grouped as Kurtas (3), Sarees (3), Shirts (2) and Dupattas (2), and category buttons show only the chosen category (plus an All option).

A size filter (XS, S, M, L, XL, XXL, Free size) and a price filter both work, can be combined, and narrow the list using each product's supplied sizes (Indigo block-print kurta S-XXL, Mustard handloom kurta S-XL, White chikankari kurta XS-XL, Khadi cotton shirt S-XXL, Linen-blend shirt M-XXL, all sarees and dupattas Free size).
Every product card has an empty photo spot and an order button that opens WhatsApp (wa.me/910000011111) with a message naming that product.
A size guide table shows chest in inches: XS 32, S 34, M 36, L 38, XL 40, XXL 42.
A visit section shows the address 18 FC Road, Shivajinagar, Pune 411005, the timings 11am to 9pm Tuesday to Sunday, closed Monday, and the shop phone +91 00000 22222.
The return and exchange policy states: exchange within 7 days if unworn with tags, and no returns on sale items.
Delivery information states: across Pune in 2 days, ₹79, free above ₹2,999, pay on delivery or UPI.
The page has a mobile viewport setting and a navigation that works on a 360px screen, with links to products, new arrivals, size guide, lookbook, visit, policy and reviews.
visitor_needs: See a lookbook of styled outfits
Read the return and exchange policy
Know delivery cost and payment options
dropped_by_requester: A New Arrivals section shows exactly: White chikankari kurta, Ikat handloom saree, Linen-blend shirt.
A Lookbook section shows 3 styled outfit ideas, each built only from named products on the site.
A reviews section shows these 3 reviews with names: "Beautiful fabric, fits perfectly" - Meera K.; "Fast delivery and lovely packing" - Arjun S.; "My go-to for festive kurtas" - Priya D.
